label: World-local termination versus union acyclicity and well-foundedness
term: world-local termination versus union acyclicity and well-foundedness
resolution: Each direct edge is world-indexed. Local support has depth at most one. The unlabeled union admits arbitrarily long predecessor descent by alternating edge labels, without a same-world two-step causal chain. No finite cycle does not mean well-founded on Nat. Finite worlds plus uniformly bounded local depth therefore cannot replace union well-foundedness. Union WF remains an independent conditional premise; this control neither refutes its metaphysical truth nor establishes a common cross-world ranking.
